items.question: How much does it cost to list my charter?
items.answer: It's 100% free! No upfront fees or hidden costs to list your charter on Fishon.

items.question: How long does registration take?
items.answer: Registration takes 10-15 minutes. Once you submit, our team will review and verify your charter within 1-2 days.

items.question: What do I need to register?
items.answer: You'll need basic charter information, boat details, photos, and information about the trips you offer.

items.question: How do I receive bookings?
items.answer: When anglers are interested in your charter, they'll contact you through the platform. You can manage all bookings through the captain dashboard.
